entities.name: Tovolar
aliases: alpha werewolf of the Mondronen howlpack
entities.description: A powerful silver-furred werewolf of Innistrad, former alpha of the Mondronen howlpack and leader of the Dire pack, and main antagonist of the Midnight Hunt storyline.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The gothic plane where Tovolar's werewolves hunt.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A planeswalker and werewolf who was once Tovolar's pupil and later his opponent; she leads her own wolf pack.

entities.name: Mondronen howlpack
entities.description: A Kessig werewolf pack of about 60 led by Tovolar, known for a dark form of magic; it disbanded after Avacyn's release.

entities.name: Dire pack
entities.description: The rapidly growing pack of dire werewolves Tovolar forms after the Travails.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: The Innistrad province where Tovolar earned his fearsome reputation.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel whose protective wards weakened in her absence and who was freed from the Helvault.

entities.name: The Helvault
entities.description: The silver sphere from which Avacyn was set free.

entities.name: The Travails
entities.description: The period of growing darkness on Innistrad after which nights grew longer.

entities.name: Dawnhart Coven
entities.description: A coven that wants to bring back the sun; Tovolar believes he can stop it.

entities.name: Harvesttide Massacre
entities.description: Tovolar's full-scale attack on the Harvesttide Festival at the Celestus.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: The key Arlinn and her allies brought to the Celestus to restore balance between night and day.

entities.name: The Celestus
entities.description: The site of the Harvesttide Festival and the planned ritual.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who casts a spell delaying the sunset during the Harvesttide attack.

entities.name: Patience
entities.description: A member of Arlinn's wolf pack who stays apart from Tovolar.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker alliance that storms the Voldaren estate.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire whose plans to control Innistrad's angels and the vampire families are opposed at the Voldaren estate.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: A vampire who pleads with Olivia to end their plans and flees with her.

entities.name: Voldaren estate
entities.description: The estate stormed by the Gatewatch.

events.summary: Twenty years ago Tovolar takes the new werewolf Arlinn Kord under his tutelage to teach her to embrace her nature.
Arlinn and Tovolar fall out when she refuses to join in slaughtering foresters; she challenges him for command of the howlpack, they wound each other and she flees.
events.quote: Arlinn turned on her mentor, challenging Tovolar for command of the howlpack

events.summary: When Avacyn is freed from the Helvault, the Mondronen and other howlpacks are disbanded, chased off and hunted by angels.
events.quote: When Avacyn was set free from The Helvault

events.summary: Two years after the Travails, Tovolar forms a growing pack of dire werewolves and plans to unify all howlpacks under his rule.
events.quote: Tovolar formed a new pack of dire werewolves that was growing rapidly

events.summary: Arlinn brings the Moonsilver Key to the Celestus, but Tovolar launches a full-scale attack on the Harvesttide Festival.
events.quote: Tovolar launched a full-scale attack upon the festival

events.summary: Teferi casts a spell to delay the sunset and stall the werewolves' transformation while planeswalkers, witches and cathars defend the humans.
events.quote: Teferi cast a powerful spell to delay the sunset

events.summary: Arlinn confronts Tovolar, who refuses to stop and urges her to join him; they fight until Tovolar calls on the wolves of her old pack and overpowers her.
Teferi's spell ends, the sun sets, and all werewolves including Arlinn transform.
events.quote: Teferi's spell finally ended and the sun set, transforming all werewolves, including Arlinn

events.summary: Arlinn's wolf pack joins Tovolar, except Patience; Arlinn feigns surrender, then severely wounds Tovolar, who retreats with the pack.
events.quote: Arlinn feigned surrender, but then overpowered the unsuspecting Tovolar and severely wounded him

events.summary: The Gatewatch storms the Voldaren estate to stop Olivia Voldaren.
events.quote: The Gatewatch and their forces stormed the Voldaren estate

events.summary: Gravely injured by Olivia, Arlinn calls for aid and Tovolar leads his wolves into battle in answer.
events.quote: Tovolar answered the call and led his wolves into battle

events.summary: Arlinn accepts Tovolar's help tracking Olivia though nothing has changed between them; they find Olivia with Edgar Markov.
events.quote: Arlinn accepted his help to track down Olivia

events.summary: Olivia drops the Moonsilver Key and flees with Edgar through a window; Arlinn and Tovolar part ways unresolved.
events.quote: Olivia dropped the Moonsilver Key and fled with Edgar through one of the windows

relations.note: taught her to embrace her werewolf nature

relations.quote: He was the alpha werewolf of the Mondronen howlpack
later became the leader of the Dire pack
He believed he could stop the Dawnhart Coven
Tovolar is a powerful werewolf on the plane of Innistrad
